description: The line plot illustrates the Micro F1 scores of different methods for generating diverse training samples for relation extraction using large language models, as a function of the number of samples generated. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated, with values of 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis represents the Micro F1 score, ranging from 25% to 50%. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different method: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The TACRED line is blue with circle markers, the TACRED-Revisit line is orange with triangle markers, the Re-TACRED line is green with diamond markers, and the SemEval line is red with star markers. The plot shows that the Micro F1 score generally increases with the number of samples generated for all methods. The SemEval method consistently has the highest Micro F1 score across all sample sizes, while the TACRED method has the lowest. The TACRED-Revisit and Re-TACRED methods show similar performance, with slight variations in Micro F1 scores at different sample sizes.
